title: Elucidating the Control of Circular Dichroism in Ion Yield via Chirped Pulses with Purposeful Models
summary: We theoretically investigate circular dichroism in the ion yield following $1+1+1$ ionization of 3-methylcyclopentanone using femtosecond linearly chirped laser pulses, inspired by recent experiments by Das et al. [Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 27, 8043 (2025)]. To this end, we numerically solve the time-dependent Schrödinger equation and evaluate the total population in the Rydberg states at the end of the second absorption step.
